character.aelith.desc: Daughter of the ancient woods, she never misses her mark beneath the silver leaves.
character.aelith.name: Aelith
character.aelith.special.desc: A fan of 9 piercing arrows in front of her.
character.aelith.special.name: Starfall Volley
character.brokk.desc: Forged in mountain rock, he takes the blows so his companions can advance.
character.brokk.name: Brokk
character.brokk.special.desc: A shockwave that hurts and stuns nearby enemies.
character.brokk.special.name: Earthquake
character.david.desc: A stalwart bulwark whose sword cleaves the dark and whose blows shake the crypts.
character.david.name: David
character.david.special.desc: A 360-degree steel whirl that hits and pushes back everything around.
character.david.special.name: Steel Whirlwind
character.grok.desc: A swamp brute with a colossal fist: little finesse, a great deal of crash.
character.grok.name: Grok
character.grok.special.desc: A huge club smash in a cone, with strong knockback.
character.grok.special.name: Troll Smash
character.mira.desc: Her twin daggers dance in the gloom, quick as a heartbeat.
character.mira.name: Mira
character.mira.special.desc: Five lightning blade strikes, invulnerable during the dance.
character.mira.special.name: Blade Dance
character.romain.desc: Swift as the wind. He talks a lot: no wait between calls, red cross every 3 s.
character.romain.name: Romain
character.romain.special.desc: An invulnerable rush that hurts the enemies it passes through.
character.romain.special.name: Scout's Rush
character.sandrine.desc: Mistress of dawnfire: she strikes from afar, but her robes are woven of nothing but courage.
character.sandrine.name: Sandrine
character.sandrine.special.desc: A fire blast in front of her: huge area damage.
character.sandrine.special.name: Blazing Nova
character.valentine.desc: Her blessed arrows fly far, and her hands raise fallen allies faster than anyone.
character.valentine.name: Valentine
character.valentine.special.desc: Heals nearby allies (40% of their HP) and hurts enemies.
character.valentine.special.name: Saving Light

level.level1.intro.1: Vaelorn is fading: the Dawn Crystal lies shattered, its shards scattered.
level.level1.intro.2: The first fragment sleeps in the Forgotten Crypts, beneath the old city.
level.level1.intro.3: Stick together, pick each other up, and don't touch anything suspicious.
level.level1.intro.4: Count on us, Master Aldric. What could possibly go wrong in a crypt?
level.level1.name: The Forgotten Crypts
level.level1.outro.1: The seal shatters in a cold breath. A crystal shard glows upon the altar.
level.level1.outro.2: At last... I am Lyssa. This first fragment gives me back a little of my voice.
level.level1.outro.3: The next shard sleeps in the Rotting Grove. Beware of the roots.
level.level1.outro.4: A rotting grove? Perfect. We remembered to pack handkerchiefs.
level.level2.intro.1: Beyond the crypts, the sacred Grove rots where it stands. Even the mushrooms creak.
level.level2.intro.2: The second fragment sleeps deep in the wood, guarded by Gorgrim, the root golem.
level.level2.intro.3: Some locks here demand separate but simultaneous deeds. Talk to each other!
level.level2.intro.4: Got it: we split up, shout loudly, and avoid the suspicious mushrooms.
level.level2.intro.5: And do not step on Gorgrim. He is very touchy.
level.level2.name: The Rotting Grove
level.level2.outro.1: The roots fall silent at last... Thank you, little ones. The fragment is yours.
level.level2.outro.2: I feel the second fragment humming. The light is returning, a little.
level.level2.outro.3: But Morvane knows you are coming. Morvane's Citadel awaits you.
level.level2.outro.4: Then let's knock on his door. Politely, with a sword.
level.level3.intro.1: Morvane's Citadel looms at the edge of the realm, black beneath a dawnless sky.
level.level3.intro.2: I can feel the third fragment. It beats like a heart deep inside the fortress.
level.level3.intro.3: Every door here is a trap built for many hands. Stay together, my friends!
level.level3.intro.4: More visitors? Come in, come in. The walls simply adore company.
level.level3.intro.5: We're coming, Morvane. Put the kettle on... and find a shield!
level.level3.name: Morvane's Citadel
level.level3.outro.1: Morvane collapses in a clatter of black crystal. The third fragment rises.
level.level3.outro.2: Three fragments hum together... but the Crystal is not whole. Some are still missing!
level.level3.outro.3: In the north, a white mist swallows the hills. Frost and darkness creep over the realm.
level.level3.outro.4: A shadow older than Morvane is waking. There are still fragments to find!

sign.level1.s_attack: Action: attack. The more of them there are, the more fun it gets. Almost.
sign.level1.s_exit: The seal gives way once every hero has done their duty.
sign.level1.s_keys: Each hero picks up the key of their color, then opens the door of that color.
sign.level1.s_kills: Everyone has a goal: check yours and leave enemies for whoever needs them.
sign.level1.s_lever: The portcullis lever is in the hall's north wing. Press Action to raise it.
sign.level1.s_levers: One lever per wing, one per hero. Pull them almost at the same time!
sign.level1.s_move: Move with the arrows or the stick. The walls, however, won't budge.
sign.level1.s_plateA: Colored plate: the hero of that color must stand on it.
sign.level1.s_plateB: Second plate, to hold at the same time. Playing solo, it is already active.
sign.level1.s_plates: Two plates, two heroes: one in the north wing, one in the south. Hold them together!
sign.level1.s_revive: An ally is down? Get close and hold Action for about 3 seconds.
sign.level1.s_seal: The circle hero holds it for 6 s on the plate. The others protect them!
sign.level1.s_torch: Your torch burns down! Press Action next to a lit brazier to refuel it.
sign.level1.s_unlit: Unlit brazier? Press Action with a non-empty torch to light it (optional).
sign.level1.s_waves: Pull the lever: waves of enemies are coming. Stay together!
sign.level1.s_wings: The keys sleep in the hall's four wings. Explore, but don't stray too far!
sign.level2.arena: Gorgrim strikes in an area: step aside! The circle of light awaits its keeper.
sign.level2.keys: Grab the key of your color, open your door, then hold your plate.
sign.level2.keysAlcoves: Keys sleep in the northern alcoves, plates in the southern cells.
sign.level2.keysDark: Your torch burns down in the dark: Action next to a lit brazier refuels it.
sign.level2.keysGrille: The gate opens when all plates are held together.
sign.level2.levers: Each lever has a color: only its player can pull it. Window: 12 s!
sign.level2.leversGate: The gate opens when all levers are active at the same time.
sign.level2.leversWings: The four levers are in the four corners of the clearing. Spread out!
sign.level2.mare: The bridges are narrow and the archers see far. Stay together.
sign.level2.mareBridges: Three bridges lead to the east bank. The islet archers shoot both ways.
sign.level2.marePlates: Each plate wakes up guardians. All of them must be held together.
sign.level2.plates: One plate per player, in their color. Hold them all at the same time!
sign.level2.platesWings: The plates lie in the four corners of the wood. Spread out!
sign.level2.runesPedestals: Use the pedestals in the announced order. A mistake: start over.
sign.level2.runesReader: Can you see runes on the altar? Describe them out loud!
sign.level2.runesWings: Six rooms hold the pedestals, all around this great hall.
sign.level3.abyss.block: Push the block together to the plate at the end of the passage.
sign.level3.abyss.bridge: A bridge leads to the island in the middle of the chasm. The green hero goes.
sign.level3.abyss.dark: Dark chasm: braziers are far apart. Refuel your torch there (Action).
sign.level3.abyss.island: The green hero holds the island plate. Archers will fire!
sign.level3.arena.bell: Pull the lever to ring the bell. Five waves await you.
sign.level3.arena.quota: The green hero must land 3 killing blows for their goal.
sign.level3.arena.waves: Stay together behind the pillars: the waves are coming!
sign.level3.balconies.corners: The levers are in the four corners of the castle. Warn each other before pulling!
sign.level3.balconies.knight: A fallen knight prowls here. Slow, but it hits hard.
sign.level3.balconies.levers: Each lever belongs to one hero. Call it out, then pull together!
sign.level3.dais.hold: The red hero holds the dais for 10 s, never leaving the round plate.
sign.level3.dais.seal: The blue hero guards the seal in the north-west chamber. Do not move!
sign.level3.dais.wings: The seal is far north-west, the dais in the center. Split up!
sign.level3.forge.block: The block moves only if two heroes push it together, head on.
sign.level3.forge.dark: Dark room: your torch burns down. Refuel it at lit braziers (Action).
sign.level3.forge.guard: Everyone else: defend the passage while the block advances!
sign.level3.forge.path: The long corridor leads to the socket. Keep pushing!
sign.level3.gate.door: The portcullis stays open once raised. Guardians wait beyond.
sign.level3.gate.plates: Each plate has a hero's color. Hold them all at the same time.
sign.level3.gate.wings: The plates hide in the four corners, in the north and south wings.
sign.level3.sanctum.chambers: The pedestals are in the six chambers around the hall. Find them!
sign.level3.sanctum.dark: Each hero has a colored brazier in a hall corner. Press Action to light it.
sign.level3.sanctum.niche: The rune niche opens once the four colored braziers are burning.
sign.level3.sanctum.pedestals: Six pedestals hide in the chambers. Strike them in order!
sign.level3.sanctum.seer: The red hero sees the rune sequence. Describe it to the others!
sign.level3.seals.chambers: The keys sleep in the four corner chambers. Explore!
sign.level3.seals.doors: Four doors, four keys. Every seal must be broken.
sign.level3.seals.keys: Pick up the key of your color: it only opens your door.
sign.level3.throne.warning: Morvane is mighty. Pillars block his shots: keep moving!
story.end.line.1: Deep in the abyss, the Void Lord is no more than stardust, and the Dawn Crystal finally shines without a shadow.
story.end.line.2: The light rises from the depths, crosses the bridges of stars and floods the whole kingdom of Vaelorn.
story.end.line.3: Lyssa whispers: "Thank you, lantern bearers. You lit the road for one another, to the very end of the night."
story.end.line.4: Aldric throws open the windows of the king's library: for the first time in centuries, Vaelorn wakes without fearing the shadow.
story.end.title: The Dawn Has Returned
